subject.title: [Feature Request] Unified Built-in Sandbox with Multi-Platform Support and Tiered Presets

question: Should maintainers keep this as the canonical sandbox/isolation tracker, or split it now into separately owned milestones for default presets, plugin/process isolation, IPC proxying, manifest policy, credential scoping, and resource limits?
rationale: The remaining work defines OpenClaw's security boundary and public config/plugin contracts, and source inspection shows current main has only partial opt-in tool sandbox groundwork.

options.title: Keep canonical and split milestones
options.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella tracker, then open maintainer-owned design or milestone issues for each security boundary before implementation.

options.title: Narrow to plugin isolation
options.body: Retitle or scope this issue to native plugin/process and credential isolation only, leaving tool-level sandboxing to existing narrower issues.

options.title: Defer broad architecture
options.body: Leave current opt-in tool sandboxing as the supported posture for now and freeze broader secure-by-default work until a product owner sponsors it.

recommendation.title: Keep canonical and split milestones
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella tracker, then open maintainer-owned design or milestone issues for each security boundary before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined signal from the live tracker discussion and recent sandbox backend/config/docs history.
